title: knx-interop capabilities document
description: The document `run capabilities` prints (docs/CONTAINER_CONTRACT.md, contract 1.5 and later): the adapter's roles, the features a runner relies on, and the stack behind it. Members the contract does not name are allowed; a runner ignores them.

adapterVersion.description: The adapter's own version, where it reports one.

features.description: Every feature is true or false; `server` holds the features of the server role. A feature the contract does not name is allowed.

upstream.description: The stack behind the adapter (contract 1.5). independentEngine is false for an image whose stack is not independent of the systems tested against it.

revision.description: The stack's commit, where the adapter knows it.
